faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most commonly asked questions.

q1.question: Which platforms are supported?
q1.answer: MediaDown supports thousands of sites including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram (Reels & Stories), Twitter/X, Facebook, Threads, Reddit, SoundCloud, and many more. yt-dlp & gallery-dl handle auto-detection.

q2.question: How do I install MediaDown?
q2.answer: Use Docker: run `docker compose up -d --build` in the root folder. Or run manually with `node backend/src/server.js` for backend and `npx vite` for frontend.

q3.question: Do I need to install cookies?
q3.answer: Cookies are optional. If a platform (e.g., YouTube) blocks anonymous access, set your account cookies via the 'Set Anti-Bot Cookies' button in the header. We do not store credentials — all data is discarded immediately.

q4.question: Can I choose video and audio quality separately?
q4.answer: Yes. In Video mode, select a video resolution (4K, 1440p, 1080p, etc.) then pair it with an audio quality (320 kbps, 128 kbps, or no audio/mute). FFmpeg muxes the streams instantly.

q5.question: What output formats are available?
q5.answer: Video: MP4, WebM, MKV. Audio: MP3, M4A/AAC, OGG, WAV (lossless), FLAC (lossless). Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or original.

q6.question: How does cross-device transfer via QR Code work?
q6.answer: Once the file is processed on the server, click 'Send / Download to Phone / Other Device'. Scan the QR Code or open the direct link on a device on the same network. Files are auto-deleted after successful download.

q7.question: Why is the download speed slow?
q7.answer: Speed depends on the source server, your network bandwidth, and server load. Ensure the URL is publicly accessible and try using the yt-dlp engine for optimal speed.

q8.question: Are files stored on the server after download?
q8.answer: No. Files are automatically deleted immediately after successfully transferring to your device. The sweeper also cleans up files not downloaded within 15 minutes.

q9.question: What is Cloudflare Turnstile?
q9.answer: Turnstile is an anti-bot protection. It is only active in production when VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY are configured. In development mode, the CAPTCHA does not appear.

q10.question: Can MediaDown be used on mobile phones?
q10.answer: Yes. The responsive interface supports phones, tablets, and desktops. On a phone, use the 'Send to Phone (QR)' feature for direct transfer from the server to your device.
